svg.title: Prompted segmentation and review scores in breast ultrasound

cc:Work.dc:title: Prompted segmentation and review scores in breast ultrasound
cc:Work.dc:description: Illustration from the locked BrEaST case 001, selected by case number. The same SAM ViT-B image embedding is used for five box prompts. The initial predicted IoU and four-mask consistency define the two review scores. An identical crop is used in each image and mask tile. Source image and reference mask: Pawłowska et al. (2024), BrEaST v1, https://doi.org/10.7937/9WKK-Q141, CC BY 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/).
